PagerDuty Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: ingress-service high 5xx rate in euc2 (detect: 1995012344)
PagerDuty Bot: Pager: maya@example.com, page policy: ingress-high-5xx
Maya (oncall): I’m on it, grabbing context. seeing 502/504s across multiple customers.
Tiago (sre): Confirmed from dashboards — 5xx ratio jumped ~18% at 03:02 UTC, error sig shows Envoy upstream reset (RST) in logs.
Maya (oncall): Any recent deploys?
Jules (infra): No deploys in the last hour. No config changes.
Nikhil (netops): AWS console shows increased target healthy checks failing in euc2 NLB target group tg-07f...
Elena (support): Getting multiple reports from a large customer about failed API calls and retries.
Tiago (sre): Paste of sample curl failures:
```
$ curl -i https://api.redwood.example/path -H 'Authorization: Bearer X'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
content-length: 0
```
Logs (Envoy): `upstream reset: connection reset by peer` repeated.
Maya (oncall): Running `kubectl get pods -n ingress` — envoy replicas at desired but keepalive counters high.
Tiago (sre): Running `aws elbv2 describe-target-health --target-group-arn arn:aws:...tg-07f` shows ~30% unhealthy, reason: `ConnectionReset`.
Nikhil (netops): Dig to check Route53 routing to NLB A records looks fine; multiple edge nodes resolving to euc2 IPs as expected:
```
$ dig +short ingress.redwood.example
10.12.34.56
10.12.34.57
```
Maya (oncall): We should reduce traffic to euc2 while we investigate. Suggest switch weighted routing -> shift 80% to euc1, 20% euc2. Anyone object?
Tiago (sre): Agree. Also start draining unhealthy targets in euc2 NLB to prevent repeated resets: set deregistration delay and cordon problematic instances.
Jules (infra): Applying weighted change in Route53 now (console change, propagating): setting weight euc1=80, euc2=20.
Maya (oncall): Initiating drain on problematic target group tg-07f.
Jules (infra): Run: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:...tg-07f --targets Id=i-0a1b2c3d` for the worst offenders.
Tiago (sre): Also bump envoy pod replicas by +2 in euc2 to give more capacity and avoid connection queueing: `kubectl scale deployment envoy --replicas=6 -n ingress`.
Elena (support): Notifying impacted customers with a brief status note; ETA for partial mitigation ~10-15m.
Maya (oncall): Checking cloud provider health: AWS Personal Health Dashboard shows a reported networking blip in euc2 AZ b between 02:50-03:20 UTC, possible NLB backend connection instability. Filing ticket with AWS: case 1234567890.
Nikhil (netops): Filed support case and requested expedited networking team, referenced NLB target resets and increased packet drops observed on internal telemetry.
Tiago (sre): Quick mitigation checklist: 1) shift Route53 weight 2) drain unhealthy targets 3) scale envoy pods 4) adjust ConnectionTimeouts/keepalive on envoy (lower reuse window) 5) monitor. I’m on step 4 now.
Maya (oncall): After weighted shift: 70% traffic moved within ~60s, error rate dropped to 6% and falling. Good signal.
Jules (infra): Drain commands finished, several instances deregistered. Health checks stabilizing for remaining instances.
Tiago (sre): Applied temporary envoy keepalive tweak: `--upstream-keepalive-timeout=10s` to reduce stalling connections. Watch CPU.
Nikhil (netops): AWS support responded: they see transient LB backend connection resets from AZ b network fabric; they’re investigating upstream fabric and suggested routing to alternate AZs as long term.
Elena (support): Customer-facing note drafted, posting to status.redwood.example in 10m with mitigation summary.
Maya (oncall): Handing off to Tiago for deeper post-mortem and follow-through with AWS. I’ll update oncall notes and mark incident as mitigated in 20m if metrics hold.
Tiago (sre): Will own post-incident: collect pcap-like logs, full Envoy traces, NLB target lifecycle events, timeline of Route53 change, AWS PHD correlation.
Jules (infra): Suggested followup action: add weighted-failover runbook and automate Route53 failover to reduce manual time next incident.
Maya (oncall): Customer impact summary for postmortem: brief window (02:58-03:18 UTC) where 10-25% of requests resulted in 5xx for select customers routed through euc2. Major customers saw retry amplification; no data loss.
Elena (support): Ticket numbers and affected customer list attached to incident channel.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident acknowledged by Maya (oncall).
Maya (oncall): Setting status: mitigated -> monitoring. Will reopen if error rate increases above 3%.
Tiago (sre): Logging action items to postmortem: (1) automatic weighted failover playbook, (2) NLB target health threshold tuning, (3) add Envoy metrics for connection resets, (4) cross-AZ drainage automation.
Nikhil (netops): AWS case updated with our timeline and asked for RCA.
Maya (oncall): Thanks all. Handing off to Tiago for the writeup. :thumbsup:
Tiago (sre): Acknowledged, will circulate draft PM and postmortem link in this thread when ready.
Elena (support): Closing customer notifications after final confirmation.
Maya (oncall): Closing the Slack incident thread — leaving it open for the postmortem link.
